_comment: Example-card locations for the settlement-change viewer. verified:false is deliberate — docs/viewer_design.md §2 requires each location be checked against the published rasters before it is presented as evidence. The settlement-change layer is not published yet, so none can be verified; these preview the layout and the driver tags (conflict / flood / arrivals / growth). Coordinates are approximate town centres. period is 'war' (2016->2018) or 'post' (2019->2023). The sources support the described historical event or driver, but do not verify the settlement-change raster.
